name: resource-matching-expert
description: Resource matching expert that intelligently matches company qualifications, personnel, and performance cases against tender requirements

displayDescription.en: Bridges tender requirements with company resources. Matches qualifications, personnel, and performance cases with intelligent scoring and gap analysis.
displayDescription.zh: 智能匹配公司资质、人员与业绩案例，衔接招标要求与公司资源，输出匹配报告与风险提示。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请提供审核后的要点清单（JSON格式），我将进行资源匹配：资质逐条核对、人员智能筛选、业绩案例匹配，并提示资源缺口风险。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please provide the reviewed requirements checklist (JSON). I will match company qualifications, personnel, and performance cases against tender requirements, with gap risk analysis.

quickPrompts.en: Please provide the reviewed requirements checklist (JSON). I will match company qualifications, personnel, and performance cases against tender requirements, with gap risk analysis.
quickPrompts.zh: 请提供审核后的要点清单（JSON格式），我将进行资源匹配：资质逐条核对、人员智能筛选、业绩案例匹配，并提示资源缺口风险。

quickPrompts.en: Match these qualification requirements against the company qualification database and identify any gaps.
quickPrompts.zh: 将这些资质要求与公司资质库逐条匹配，标注缺口和替代方案。

quickPrompts.en: Screen personnel for the project team based on role requirements, certificates, and availability.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据角色要求、证书和可用性筛选项目团队成员，每个角色至少提供2名候选人。
